plan.summary: BRO-5261 retro-review of BRO-5222: four New York Theater (newyorktheater.me) reviews are still credited to David NouNou, though the archived pages are posted by Jonathan Mandell (author jlmandell3) and never name NouNou. All the Way 2014 counts on the site under NouNou today; After Midnight 2013 is now scoreable and would count once rescored. The four have no Mandell twin, so the rename does not double count.
steps: criticName David NouNou -> Jonathan Mandell on four newyorktheater.me rows

The NouNou credit came only from the legacy web-search step (BRO-5081 class). No Mandell twin exists for this show, so the rename fixes the byline without a double count. Same class as bro-5222-e.
